title: Hallucination: why it happens and how to reduce it

videos.script: Ask a model for a source, and it may give you one that does not exist. The authors, the title, the page numbers, all of it invented. {{citation}} That is called a hallucination. It sounds like a malfunction, and it is not one. {{name}} The model is doing exactly what it always does. It writes the most likely next piece of text. {{likely}} Most of the time, likely and true are the same thing. A hallucination is a time they are not, and the text gives no sign of the difference. {{gap}} In this lesson a tiny model answers, with complete confidence, a question its training text never mentions. {{toy}} Then you work through what actually reduces the problem. Put the facts in front of the model. Let it say it does not know. Ask for quotes you can check, and check them. {{reduce}} And you see why turning the temperature down is not on that list. {{temperature}}
